items.html: And this is what is said: 'this Hochma is the beginning of everything,' because through it everything below it was made and emanated, in the clothing of the bone in it. And this is the meaning of 'beginning.' And from it the brain of ZA spreads into the thirty-two paths, for in it there is no spreading at all, until it descends to ZA. And even in ZA they are narrow paths, and not wide ways, for they are still hidden, being near to Aba, who goes out of the holy Atik; and the Torah, in this Hochma, is included in the twenty-two letters and the ten utterances, and afterward, below in ZA, it is revealed more; but here it is included in concealment.
